periods.description: A well-known trio of academy students—Sharis, Tillfur, and Noct—who patrol the girls' dormitory, support academy order, and fight as Knight Squadron members.
periods.history: The three are childhood friends and known within the academy as the Triad. They first appear pursuing Lux after the bath incident.
periods.goals: Protect academy students, enforce dormitory safety, and support Knight Squadron operations.
periods.structure: Informal three-person team led practically by Sharis, with Tillfur as lively coordinator and Noct as calm support/scout.
